callsUsed.title: Homestead/entrata - Leasing Center Touchbase
callsUsed.brief: Sarah needs Entrata to handle after-hours emergency maintenance calls for all properties, but is having trouble configuring the call settings. Vincent, a project manager, is looping in a consultant (Casey) and the original trainer (Ashley) to resolve the issue, as the necessary IVR settings are part of a "red product" feature they may not have access to. Vincent will create a communication channel for updates once he reviews a training video Sarah will provide.

callsUsed.title: Entrata/Elford - Commercial Discussion
callsUsed.brief: Dan spoke with Vince and Michelle regarding their concerns about the lack of development on Entrata's commercial product, particularly unresolved issues with cam pools and reconciliation. Dan committed to involving the development team to investigate and resolve these issues, aiming to provide a plan by Thursday and schedule a follow-up meeting. Vince and Michelle expressed frustration with long-standing problems and the impact on their business, emphasizing the need for the software to function as expected.

callsUsed.title: Entrata/Elford - Intro & LC Discussion
callsUsed.brief: The call addressed ongoing issues with the Entrata leasing center implementation, with Entrata introducing a new account manager, Rustin, and offering a credit to compensate for past difficulties. The leasing center team, led by Cynthia and Tesla, outlined a plan to optimize call routing and improve the resident experience by implementing unique maintenance numbers for each property and customizing the IVR. Entrata committed to providing direct support and ongoing communication to ensure a smoother transition and resolution of the outstanding issues.

callsUsed.title: Entrata/Elford - Quickbooks to Entrata Discussion
callsUsed.brief: Dan from Elford Asset Management sought a solution to streamline check processing for management fees in Entrata, aiming to avoid manual processes. Ryan and Katie from Entrata recommended leveraging the corporate functionality and intercompany invoices, while addressing concerns about Check 21 integration and payroll reimbursements. Dan plans to set up the system himself and will seek consulting assistance as needed to optimize functionality.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Consulting
callsUsed.brief: Trent from Entrata guided Dan from Elford Asset Management on transitioning from QuickBooks to Entrata, focusing on setting up intercompany functionality for automatic management fee posting. They discussed vendor setup, template configuration, charge codes, and the timing of posting fees to ensure accurate financial reporting, with Trent offering a follow-up email summarizing key steps and investigating a custom report request. Dan plans to test the new setup with a few properties before fully implementing it.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Entrata Pricing Demo
callsUsed.brief: The call was a demo of Entrata's revenue management system for Michelle and Sarah, who had previously seen it a few years ago and wanted to review updates. Alex, the sales engineer, presented the system's features and methodology, and Michelle inquired about competitor data weighting and the auto-publish feature. Phone Caller #2 will follow up with pricing, a spec sheet, a use case, and the call recording, and Alex will be available for further technical questions.

callsUsed.title: Entrata/Elford Development - Commercial/Budgeting Discussion
callsUsed.brief: The Entrata team, including a returning commercial expert, John, and a budgeting expert, Chris, met with Dan and his team to address issues with CAM pools, budgeting, and reconciliation within Entrata's commercial property management system. They discussed solutions for importing budgets, setting caps on expenses, generating percentage rent reports, and improving the accuracy of CAM reconciliations, as well as the implementation of a new test site for experimentation. The Entrata team offered ongoing support and collaboration to resolve these issues and enhance the system's functionality.

callsUsed.title: Budgeting with Elford
callsUsed.brief: The call focused on upcoming Entrata features for budgeting, including improved GPR assumptions, GL account referencing in custom formulas, and enhanced reporting capabilities with comment exports. The team discussed the potential value of these features, particularly for commercial real estate, and requested improvements like worksheet-based reforecasting and better integration of variance notes. A follow-up meeting was scheduled to address specific pain points and explore a potential switch to the rapid release to meet the October 1st budget deadline.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Colleen AI Demo
callsUsed.brief: The call was a product overview of Colleen AI, recently acquired by Entrata, focusing on its capabilities in rent collection, renewals, and upcoming leasing features. Alicia from a property management company expressed interest, particularly in the leasing aspect, and inquired about its integration with their existing systems and data. The team agreed to share conversation logs and schedule a follow-up to address further questions after Alicia's review.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Sync
callsUsed.brief: Michelle and Rustin discussed Entrata taking over insurance verification for $0.50 per unit per month, effectively canceling out the current $6 kickback. Michelle expressed interest in switching to Entrata's master policy, which covers properties when a resident's insurance lapses for $9.80, and requested information on the master policy and lease language for review.

callsUsed.title: Elford + entrata - Advanced Budgeting Follow-up
callsUsed.brief: "Phone Caller #1 expressed concerns that the advanced budgeting system is not functional for commercial properties, specifically regarding revenue caps and integration with CAM pools, and will continue to use Excel. Rustin and Landon acknowledged the issues and suggested contacting product manager Christopher Koontz, who is already aware of the concerns, to influence future updates, though commercial functionality may not be prioritized until next year."

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Bill Pay Demo
callsUsed.brief: Dan and Terry discussed a bill pay solution with Phone Caller #3 and Phone Caller #1 to streamline their accounts payable process, addressing concerns about check fraud and postal delays. The proposed system would automate vendor payments via ACH or check, with vendors securely entering their bank information, and would integrate with their existing accounting system, potentially simplifying the payment process and improving security. Dan expressed interest and will discuss the proposal internally before moving forward with implementation.

callsUsed.title: Commercial Chat
callsUsed.brief: The call focused on CAM charge proration, budget management, and the functionality of the "controllable" switch in Entrata, specifically regarding its impact on capping expenses. The team identified a critical limitation where a GL number cannot be simultaneously designated as controllable for one tenant and non-controllable for another, hindering accurate expense allocation. John committed to investigating solutions with the engineering team and scheduling a follow-up to address these issues.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Marketing Demo
callsUsed.brief: The call aimed to introduce the marketing strategy hub, but it was discovered that Michelle's company doesn't have a contract for it. The focus shifted to understanding the features they *do* have, with a plan to review their contract and schedule a consulting call to explore existing capabilities and potential benefits of the digital marketing bundle and leasing AI (releasing in Q1).

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Eli+ Demo
callsUsed.brief: Entrata presented their "Eli" AI suite, including Leasing AI (Colleen), Payments AI, and Renewals AI, highlighting features like automated lead engagement, proactive payment reminders, and streamlined renewal processes. These AI products are add-ons to existing services, with pricing available upon request, and Entrata also announced a new AI-powered bulk invoice entry feature and AI enhancements to the message center. The team discussed current and future capabilities, integration with existing Entrata systems, and potential benefits for efficiency and resident communication.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Rent Reporting & Contract Sync
callsUsed.brief: The call focused on rent reporting, the leasing center, and advanced budgeting, with Michelle expressing initial concerns about auto-enrollment in rent reporting, which were addressed by clarifying the optional nature of the addendum. Michelle agreed to proceed with rent reporting after reviewing the information with her team, add the insurance product, remove advanced budgeting, and terminate the leasing center service in favor of an external AI solution, also scheduling a demo for AI invoice processing. The team also discussed the timeline for these changes and the associated costs.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development AI Invoicing Demo
callsUsed.brief: The call was a demonstration of Entrata's AI-powered invoice processing functionality, presented by Eric Perez, to Rustin Fairbanks, Michelle, and Dan. The AI tool aims to streamline invoice processing by automating data extraction, though it has limitations with utility bills, complex allocations, and handwritten notes. Rustin Fairbanks will follow up with pricing information and a recap of the call to discuss potential implementation.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Floor Plan Sync
callsUsed.brief: The call involved Phone Caller #1 and Phone Caller #2 troubleshooting a software issue for a client named Alicia, who is having difficulty with the unit selection process. They suspect Alicia's issue stems from a misunderstanding of how the system prompts for unit selection and the relationship between unit selection and pricing, and they plan to contact her to better understand her workflow and desired outcome. They believe the issue is easily resolvable once they understand Alicia's needs.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Eli+Invoice Processing Demo
callsUsed.brief: The call was a demonstration of Eli Plus invoice processing software, which aims to reduce workload by automating invoice data entry. The system can read various invoice formats, including PDFs and potentially Excel files, and extract key information like vendor, property, and GL account, though some manual review is still required. The team discussed specific scenarios, such as handling utility bills and handwritten invoices, and confirmed the existing approval process would remain unchanged.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Floor Plan Sync
callsUsed.brief: Rustin assisted a client experiencing a significant drop in leads after transitioning to Entrata websites, identifying that the primary issue was the improper use of vanity phone numbers for lead source tracking in Elford's and SPS. He clarified the importance of using Entrata's vanity numbers for accurate tracking and advised on the correct setup within the Entrata platform, also suggesting that future support-related issues should be addressed through consulting contracts rather than scoping calls.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Rent Reporting Sync
callsUsed.brief: The call centered on Alicia's concerns about the rent credit building product being presented as opt-out rather than opt-in, fearing it would be perceived as deceptive by residents. Despite the product being presented as part of the lease with an option to decline, Alicia wants to explore alternative implementation methods and will follow up with a proposal after consulting with her team, while Vince emphasized the contractual requirements and offered a trial period with potential cancellation. The team will discuss internally and propose next steps.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Bill Pay
callsUsed.brief: Dan contacted Rustin to discuss issues with Avid, their payment processor, specifically regarding returned electronic payments and reconciliation problems. Rustin and Vince offered a demo of Entrata's payment system to address Dan's concerns and compare it to Avid, focusing on vendor payment options, notification processes, and control over payment methods. A demo is scheduled for the following week to explore Entrata's capabilities and address Dan's specific questions about limitations and control.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Bill Pay Follow up Demo
callsUsed.brief:
Here is a brief synopsis of the call:

Dan's team is experiencing significant issues with AvidXchange, particularly regarding virtual card payments, reconciliation, and lack of visibility. They are considering switching to Entrata, which Rustin presented as a solution offering better control over payment methods, improved visibility into payment status, and streamlined processes for both vendors and residents. Dan's team will discuss internally and inform Rustin of their decision by the end of the week.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Precise ID and Income Verification Demo
callsUsed.brief: Alex, the sales engineer, presented Precise ID and income verification tools to Phone Caller #2, who is considering them to enhance their fraud detection process. Phone Caller #2 expressed interest in Precise ID due to its ability to cross-reference application data with Experian data, but is hesitant about income verification due to their existing reliance on parent letters; pricing and next steps were discussed, with Phone Caller #3 agreeing to send a recap and pricing information for Phone Caller #2 to discuss with Michelle.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Elford Development Consulting Call
callsUsed.brief: The call focused on troubleshooting issues with Entrata's CAM reconciliation process, specifically regarding GL account integration, budget accuracy, and system bugs. The team discussed workarounds for system limitations, like budgeting a dollar for potential expenses, and identified several bugs, including issues with reversing journal entries and incorrect percentage calculations. They agreed to follow up in early December to review budgets, CAM pools, and reconciliation processes, and to submit bug tickets to Entrata for resolution.

Entrata offered solutions and resources for review, including a new master service agreement with capped annual renewals.
